messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — SpruceCommerce renewal in ~6 weeks. We’re seeing a ~45% drop in API p95 and active seat usage down ~40% MoM. Procurement pinged to say they're talking to Comp.ai. Marking this renewal as at-risk. Can we triage?

Jordi (AM): Thanks Maya. Do we have a usage export? Who's owner for technical touch?

Connor (Solutions): I pulled a quick query — last 30d calls by route: /generate 2.3M, /embed 140k, active seats 12 -> 7. Dropped mainly on embedding and scheduled batch jobs. Snippet: ```select date_trunc('day', ts) day, count(*) calls from requests where org='spruce' and ts > now() - interval '30 days' group by 1 order by 1;``` I'll share chart.

Aisha (Renewals): Procurement timeline: RFP responses due in 3 weeks; they said cost + SLA + data residency. They liked Redwood's Dedicated offering but want a performance proofpoint vs competitor. They're asking for a side-by-side latency/cost estimate.

Kevin (CS Ops): @Aisha can you forward the procurement email? I'll coordinate a performance test. Also we should run a targeted QBR with their PM/eng in next 10 days.

Connor (Solutions): I can run a 2-hour perf smoke on our dedicated infra and produce a 1-page comparison: latency percentiles, token cost estimate, and suggested quantization profile. Need a test dataset and a list of canonical prompts.

Maya (CSM): I'll ask Spruce to provide their top-10 prompt patterns and a sample payload. I'll also offer a 30-min enablement + migration checklist call.

Jordi (AM): Suggest we offer a short pilot: 1-week dedicated capacity trial with SLA for the procurement team to validate. Should we price it as a time-boxed eval?

Aisha (Renewals): Yes — offer a no-commitment eval with clear scope. I'll own the commercial offset. @Connor please prepare test harness.

renewals-bot: Reminder: renewal for SpruceCommerce (acct: SPR-00214) scheduled in 42 days.

Kevin (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Maya — get prompt samples + procurement thread (due EOD 2210000462) 2) Connor — perf test plan + estimate (due 2210000520) 3) Aisha — draft pilot offer and commercial note (due 2210000500) 4) Jordi — schedule QBR invite for next Tue 10-11am PT (tentative). I'll create a quick playbook doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/CS/Spruce-usage-triage

Maya (CSM): noted. I'll ping their PM now. @Jordi can you own the QBR invite if I get stakeholder list?

Jordi (AM): Yup, I'll send once I have names.

Connor (Solutions): Also flag — embedding jobs are scheduled nightly from their analytics pipeline; if we can recommend caching / dedupe it may reduce cost a lot. I'll draft suggestions.

Aisha (Renewals): Good point. If we can show 30-40% unit cost reduction via caching + batching that's a strong retention play.

Maya (CSM): I'll close the loop after PM reply. Who wants to be on the QBR call from our side? Connor + Aisha + me?

Kevin (CS Ops): +Jordi on agenda and we'll include a short demo of our Dedicated perf.

Connor (Solutions): I'll prepare 10-slide deck + perf graphs.

Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: thanks team. Will update thread with PM reply.
